_rules.no_cross_account_sum: the six ledgers must never be added into one workload number
_rules.product_only_for_table: only the product_run ledger can feed the formal comparison table
_rules.recompute: every number above is re-read from its frozen artifact by JSON pointer
_rules.unknown_never_scored: an unknown verdict keeps score_for_aggregate null and is excluded from both numerator and denominator

bare_model_probe.definition: the same model called without any product Harness, to separate model behaviour from Harness behaviour
bare_model_probe.empty_reason: no attested shared model endpoint exists for the five products, so a bare probe cannot be matched to a product run; an unmatched probe would not change any five-product conclusion
bare_model_probe.stop_condition: reopen only when one product's exact model is both disclosed and reachable outside its Harness

grader_regression.definition: synthetic answers used to test the judge; never product output

interface_preflight.definition: reading configuration surfaces and endpoints; counts zero product tasks

offline_recompute.definition: recomputation of already published bytes; produces no new product run

items.label: 归因边界复核的新增产品运行

product_run.definition: an actually submitted product task/session with its own configuration, start and end, and retained evidence

self_test.definition: offline regression suite over the evaluation kit; runs no product
